purpose: Explicit review ledger for maintained files broadly suspected of opening physical Hint artifacts. New suspects fail the hostile audit until classified.

entries.rationale: Direct JSON.parse reads block/manifest documents; canonical parent/output Hint state is loaded and written through level-data-io.
Intentionally asserts physical v4 representation/migration behavior; semantic equality is separately checked through decodeHintArtifact.
The audit reads its own JSON review ledger and source files to detect physical-reader patterns; it does not consume Hint artifact semantics.
Physical Hint fixtures are decoded through decodeHintArtifact; other JSON reads are workbench reports/patches.
Canonical Node physical Hint I/O owner; parseHintFileContents delegates to decodeHintArtifact and stringifyHints delegates to encodeHintArtifact.
Whole-store referee validator opens canonical physical Hint artifacts only to decode them immediately through decodeHintArtifact before semantic path validation.
